name: Offense
overview: Scripture teaches that offenses among believers are serious matters that can harden hearts and create barriers, as a brother offended is described as harder to win than a strong city (Proverbs 18:19). Believers are called to love their neighbors without bearing grudges or seeking revenge, reflecting God's command to love as He commands (Leviticus 19:18). Wisdom counsels restraint and discretion in anger, highlighting the glory in overlooking transgressions (Proverbs 19:11), while trusting in God's peace to protect from stumbling over offenses (Psalms 119:165). Additionally, caution is urged in heeding all words to avoid unnecessary hurt (Ecclesiastes 7:21), underscoring the need for grace and patience in relationships within the body of Christ.
